label: miR-874 mimic
caveats: MCF7 cells, 36 h. One culture per group, split into three pseudo-replicates. Treated and control are separate libraries. miR-874 drives apoptosis by 36 h, so dying cells may be included.

label: miR-365 mimic
caveats: Heart muscle cells, 48 h. No neutral control: raising against lowering the same miRNA, so the effect is not one-sided. One library per group, split into three pseudo-replicates.

label: miR-98 mimic
caveats: H9 stem cells. Two paired time points, days 2 and 3, with the day as batch; independent cultures are not established. The early window was chosen after later days lost the seed effect. let-7 family.

label: miR-192 mimic
caveats: Blood immune cells. Control is saline, with no control-mimic nanoparticle, so the carrier response is in the effect. GEO says saline 24 h, the paper says 4 h. Hashed into one lane, three pseudo-replicates.

label: miR-365 antimiR
caveats: Heart muscle cells from a patient line, 48 h. Lowers the miRNA. Hashed into one lane, groups unbalanced about 3 to 1, treatment tags inferred from the pooling ratio, three pseudo-replicates.

label: miR-18a knockout
caveats: A375 cells. One knockout clone; merged libraries, so three pseudo-replicates.

label: miR-449a and miR-340-5p
caveats: RD18 single nuclei, 60 h. Two miRNAs delivered together, no control mimic, three pseudo-replicates.

label: let-7i and miR-452
caveats: Heart muscle cells. Two miRNAs raised together, few cells, three pseudo-replicates.
